integrity.calculation: Explicit independent polygon-area, return-roof, density and cutoff derivations
integrity.primary_geometry: Takahashi and Iwao 2007, cited and acknowledged

scientific_limitations: The computation is for the single specified max-plus QRT homeomorphism and Haar-area rather than arclength sampling.
The area-twist is not a perturbative KAM stability theorem.
Published geometric return data are inputs; the area-weighted rotation distribution is the new calculation.
The author-hosted manuscript was available in the Springer hardcover on 2006-05-31 (day-precise); earlier circulation at the 2002 workshop or from drafts has not been dated.
title: Exact action-twist and Pareto rotation spectrum of a max-plus QRT map
